name: Ephedrine
summary: Ephedrine is a sympathomimetic amine commonly used as a stimulant, concentration aid, decongestant, appetite suppressant, and to treat hypotension associated with anaesthesia. A methamphetamine analogue and commonly used in the production of methamphetamine.

warnings.text: Never with an MAOI, including Syrian rue, harmala or ayahuasca. A 19-year-old died of multiple organ failure in January 2023 after taking 24 ephedrine asthma tablets, then drinking a home brew of Syrian rue (harmala) and acacia bark boiled for over an hour and a half. Together they can push blood pressure high enough to cause bleeding in the brain and heart failure.

pharmacology.text: Ephedrine, a sympathomimetic amine, acts on part of the sympathetic nervous system (SNS). The principal mechanism of action relies on its indirect stimulation of the adrenergic receptor system by increasing activation of α- and β-adrenergic receptors via induction of norepinephrine release. The presence of direct interactions with α-adrenergic receptors is unlikely but still controversial.

uses.text: Ephedrine is a central nervous system (CNS) stimulant and sympathomimetic agent that is often used to prevent low blood pressure during anesthesia. It has also been used for asthma, narcolepsy, and obesity but is not the preferred treatment. It can be taken by mouth or by injection into a muscle, vein, or just under the skin.
uses.recreational: As a phenethylamine, ephedrine has a similar chemical structure to amphetamines and is a methamphetamine analog having the methamphetamine structure with a hydroxyl group at the β position.

sideEffects.text: Common side effects include trouble sleeping, anxiety, headache, hallucinations, high blood pressure, fast heart rate, loss of appetite, and urinary retention. Serious side effects include stroke and heart attack.

summaryZh: 麻黃鹼（英語：ephedrine）是一種中樞神經系統 (簡稱CNS) 興奮劑，常用於預防麻醉期間出現的低血壓。它也用於治療氣喘、發作性嗜睡病和肥胖症，但均非首選藥物。它在治療鼻塞的益處尚不清楚。給藥方式有口服、肌肉注射、靜脈注射或皮下注射。靜脈注射後生效最快，肌肉注射將需20分鐘，口服則需要1小時才能開始作用。
